notes.title: Carrying things and spoiling food
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/0cdf215bbaad9c082ae945c4f4042e8acfbe20ad.gif

Inventory mechanics and micro-management of items and resources are very important aspects of the game. Each item has two main characteristics - size and weight. The game has a large number of containers for carrying items. They, in turn, are subdivided into specialized and common.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/8e0290213a0773dc8fc81a78420b7460eb256d19.png

Specialized containers can only hold items of a certain category. For example, a bandolier has a large number of slots, but only cartridges can be placed in it. Also there are first-aid kits which can only store medicines, and quivers for arrows.

Special mention should be made of such containers as scrapers and carts. They allow you to carry a truly huge amount of items and resources, but this will require the use of both hands, which, in turn, entails fewer available opportunities in battle and slows down movement on the global map. By the way, it will not be possible to cross the river without using a raft with such containers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/9e577304fe081d9c902061f91daaeb0f5e1daa7a.png

Any bag or scraper wears out over time, and when it happens, a hole may form in the container. This slot will become unavailable, and at the moment the hole appears the item that was in this slot will drop out.
The decay mechanic is found in most survival games, and Lost Scavenger is no exception. Each product has a status bar that decreases over time. If it drops to zero, the food is considered to be spoiled.
 
Information about this can be obtained in the product properties. The spoiled products can be eaten, but at the same time, the character's scale of intoxication rises, plus other negative effects are possible: diarrhea, vomiting and other diseases.

So keep a close eye on your gear and what you eat!

Well, in conclusion - a small inventory diagram with explanations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/e690f04b7efb186471c4db3b77c51addfa44d43a.jpg

1. Item's condition - reflects the quality and degree of wear.
2. Spoiled food - you can still eat it, but at your own peril and risk...
3. The number of items in the stack.
4. The available amount of ammunition for this weapon.
5. The current number of items in the container.
6. Holes in the container - they block slots. If a hole appears on a slot occupied by an object, it falls to the ground.

notes.title: Crafting mechanics. Part 2
notes.content:
I am worried that in Lost Scavenger, in my basic system learning the blueprint (opening the exact positions of materials), described in previous  issues, there will be no place for deliberate experiment, but only a quick drain of components in failed attempts in exchange for opening positions. In this regard, the idea was born to make this process in the spirit Battleship (game).

Let's consider the process step by step using the example of such a random blueprint.

First attempt:
We received a new blueprint, we know the necessary materials, but we do not know the positions, so we spread them randomly and click "Create":

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/5b2732649ff7cb399fa5817415ca8e73a2563080.png

Failure:
• All materials destroyed
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• Material Bandage occupies only one square and was fully discovered (1), so now we see it as a slot for a material (according to the rules of current slots)
• A random cell of the material is discovered (2)
Now our drawing looks like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d13395286e86d1eb55b61381c49ef21f9395ef77.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/f2f97b368ec3f838d116e5f25a1e4cf5b9a2371e.png

Second attempt:
Seeing the open tips, we try to guess the location of the materials again. The bandage is discovered, so we cannot place it in any other place other than its slot (according to the rules of the current slots).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/025cfac5bf0bb7bed29521479690ee8bff80f885.png

Failure:
• The axe and knife are destroyed, the bandage remains because it was in the correct position.
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• A random cell of the material is discovered (1)

Now our blueprint looks like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/5b2c50a001aa418947608d4f2cf6490fe72afdba.png

3rd attempt:
Looking at the hints, we understand the position of the axe, trying to discover the knife, but...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d1b91f663cebfb710edcb7d7db5b21ab856b3297.png

...failure again:
• The knife is destroyed, the bandage and axe remain because they were in the correct positions.
• The axe slot is discovered.
• All cells under the materials are marked as "hit" / "missed"
• Open one random cell of the material (1). Since only one cell of the material (1) is hidden, open the knife slot

The blueprint is discovered:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/433ab6f3ce0ec338c6f60be34b1581a2e7875cf0.png

Summary:

We get an interesting minigame as a craft, where the speed of discovering the blueprint depends on luck and intelligence, moreover, you do not sacrifice ready-made functionality, but only supplement it. Without such a mechanic, no one will try to guess the exact position of the material, but simply burn the materials until all slots are open, i.e. the position of the slots on the table will be empty mechanics.
Accidentally unlocked slots on a failure serve as compensation and help guide the player to avoid burning too many resources in the beginning, especially in recipes with single-celled materials.
Parsing an item opens a blueprint, subsequent parsing opens 1 random cell of the material.

So this is the second variant of craft mechanic in Lost Scavenger. What do you think, is it worth it? Thank you!

notes.title: Crafting mechanic. Pt.1
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I would like to talk about a mechanic of crafting in Lost Scavenger. Main emphasis of the game is on surviving in a hostile environment, simulating the needs of the body (food, medicine, temperature, etc.) and finding and crafting items you need for this uneasy case. It is about the latter that I would like to tell, or rather, about a part of it.

So, the game focuses on crafting items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/66b736185409d30c0e960c82939e4c587852226b.jpg

During the game our character will constantly have to make or cook something to survive. Most of the categories of items can be made from both primitive improvised materials and from higher quality materials collected from the remains of civilization. To fix the fracture, you put on a medical splint, or you just can make an impromptu one from branches and ropes.

To make an item of proper quality, you will need:

Discover the blueprint - this will give information about the components, tools and requirements for its manufacture. This can be done in the following ways:

- to read in a newspaper or book, which sometimes come across when searching urban areas.

- ask the NPC for money or during the quest.

- sometimes blueprint can be recognized when disassembling the item.

- experiment! Nothing prevents you from taking a stick, knife, rope and attempting to create a primitive spear. It is not a fact that you will succeed, and some of the components will be destroyed if your attempt fails, but Fortune favors the brave! =)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/983f36206bbbfda247637c9fa48e78fd8d3f014d.jpg

2. Learn how to do it

The process studying is expressed in the discovery of the exact positions of each component on the crafting table - each item which is out of its position will significantly reduce the final quality (strength) of the item received. If the durability is below zero, the item will not be crafted. The process of opening these positions is a lot like opening the blueprint itself. We can:

- continue to disassemble items.

- try to create an item by placing components on the table at random - in case of failure, some of the components will be destroyed, but the position of one of them will be open. It will also discover the position of the component you guessed it at.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/d9e78c6fe809b9c5b31ca812ada00db5f5bbc096.jpg

The chance of opening a position depends on item’s tire - the more complicated the item, the longer it takes to learn to do it. Some perks and character’s background speed up this process, increasing the chance of opening a position of materials or opening 2 positions at a time - I want smart characters to have the same chances of surviving as strong ones. =)

3. When the most difficult thing is over, it remains only to find materials and tools of suitable quality! It is also worth to keep in mind that complex recipes may require a character’s specialized perks or workshop, which can only be used in some settlements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40707048/dd7e3f45aea4095b1b357e64b953ad32e780d80e.jpg

Basic blueprints and recipes like bonfire, boiling water, club, etc. will be available at the beginning of the game, the rest will have to be made in the process. The quality of the crafted item depends on the quality of the raw materials and the tools used, which, by the way, wear out in the process.

My main task is to make the craft process, on the one hand, not casual, but on the other, not too routine, because you will have to resort to it often. I will tell you more about the existing crafting model, interface, as well as an alternative idea in the next issues.
